name: app.betterkid/betterkids-parent-guide
title: BetterKids Parent Guide
description: Read-only BetterKids parent guide: age-matched activities, daily plans, app links and safety facts.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: Find BetterKids activities that fit a child's age, a skill and the minutes you have. Searches the app's real content catalog (232 activities across 14 areas: Hero Training, Leo's Piano, Nature Explorer, World Explorer, Little Swimmer, Little Dojo, Jobs, Car Explorer, math, mazes, coding and English words). Send age_years OR age_months (the app covers ages 3-9), optionally skill, area, minutes (the most minutes one go may take) and needs_grown_up. Each result has an id, English and Vietnamese titles, age bands, skill tags, typical minutes (with whether it is computed, stated by the app or an estimate), a one-line how-to and whether the app's notes ask a grown-up to be nearby. Read-only, no account, no network calls. Never include a child's name or any personal detail.

age_years.description: Child's age in whole years (1-18). Provide age_years OR age_months, not both. The app's content covers ages 3-9.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216). Provide age_months OR age_years, not both. The app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9).

skill.description: Filter by skill tag (see list_topics for the list).

area.description: Filter by app area, for example piano, nature, hero-training, maze.

minutes.description: Only activities that take at most this many minutes per go.

needs_grown_up.description: true = only activities where the app's notes ask a grown-up to be nearby; false = only those that do not.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Get everything the catalog says about one activity by id: titles in English and Vietnamese, age bands, minutes, the app's step-by-step wording, reps or seconds per age band where the app defines them, and the area's grown-up tips with their sources. Use ids returned by list_activities. Read-only and free of personal data.

id.description: Activity id from list_activities, for example hero.frog-jumps or piano-song.hot-cross-buns.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List every area of the BetterKids app (for example piano, nature, hero-training, maze), the skill tags, the three age bands (3-4, 5-6, 7-9) and how many activities each has, plus the catalog digest. Call this first to learn valid values for the skill and area filters of list_activities. Read-only; takes no input.

tools.name: suggest_daily_plan
tools.description: Suggest a short play-and-learn plan for one day from the app's catalog: send the child's age in months (36-119 for ages 3-9), up to 8 interests such as "animals" or "piano" (English or Vietnamese) and the minutes available. Returns an ordered list of activities that fit the minutes, with a reason for each; the same inputs always give the same plan and `day` (1-7) varies it across a week. It starts where the app itself starts the day and flags activities where the app asks a grown-up to be nearby. A suggestion, not a prescription, with no developmental claims. Read-only; interests are matched against the catalog and never echoed or stored. Never send a child's name.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216); the app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9). Never send a name.

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests such as "animals", "piano", "maze", "cars" (English or Vietnamese). Words that match no area are ignored. Never include names or personal details.

day.description: Day of the week 1-7. Changes which equally good activities are picked, so a week of plans varies. The same inputs always give the same plan.

tools.name: how_to_teach
tools.description: Get the app's own steps for playing or practising a topic with a child. topic can be an activity id, an area id, a skill or a plain topic such as "jump rope", "doctor", "swimming" or "piano"; optionally add the child's age to see only suitable activities. Returns catalog-backed steps in English and Vietnamese (including the seated, gentler and grown-up versions of movement activities), reps or seconds per band and grown-up tips with sources. Nothing is invented: if the catalog has no match, it says so. Read-only; never send a name.

topic.description: An activity id (hero.frog-jumps), an area id (piano), a skill (balance) or a plain topic ("jump rope", "doctor", "twinkle", "swimming"). Never a name.

age_years.description: Child's age in whole years (1-18). Provide age_years OR age_months, not both. The app's content covers ages 3-9.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216). Provide age_months OR age_years, not both. The app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9).

tools.name: app_info
tools.description: Where to get the BetterKids app and what is available today: iPhone and iPad (App Store, 1.0.6), Mac (Mac App Store, 1.0.1 live), Android (NOT in the public Google Play: a direct APK from GitHub Releases) and the web app. Links are given only for what is publicly available, with version numbers and the date they were checked. Also returns languages, the pricing model in one sentence (no prices) and support and privacy links. Read-only.

tools.name: safety_facts
tools.description: What a parent usually asks before installing: ads, the grown-up gate, accounts, which data leaves the device, analytics, device permissions, AI usage, contact with others and physical safety. Each statement says which platforms it covers and lists the repo files it was verified against; a not_claimed list says what is deliberately not promised. Read-only; takes no input.

tools.name: age_guide
tools.description: Describe what each age band (3-4, 5-6, 7-9) gets in the app, from the real content: for example the daily activity for ages 3-4, repeat blocks in Code Quest from 5-6, one-way roads and traffic lights in mazes at 7-9. Returns counts of activities per area and sourced statements. These are facts about the app's content, not developmental milestones or advice. Send band, age_years or age_months, or nothing for all three. Read-only.

band.description: One age band (3-4, 5-6 or 7-9). Omit to get all three.

age_years.description: Child's age in whole years (1-18). Provide age_years OR age_months, not both. The app's content covers ages 3-9.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216). Provide age_months OR age_years, not both. The app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9).
